title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.8
subtitle: Water Flow preparation in the Bake Window.

highlights.title: Prepare Water Flow with progress
highlights.description: Prepare .gaia water fields in the existing Bake Window. Source checks and reconstruction run in a worker, with progress and cancellation available.

highlights.title: Choose where the new file belongs
highlights.description: GAIA Path accepts a new file name or a folder. Leave it empty to use the Cloth cache folder; the derived container uses the .gaia extension.

highlights.title: A consistent Water Flow card
highlights.description: Aligned Physics controls, a separate Flow Display section and the new monochrome GAIA icon make the tools easier to scan.
